SELECT
  COALESCE(s.current_state, 'INFO')   AS current_state,
  COALESCE(s.cascade_count, 0)        AS cascade_count,
  s.last_event_time IS NULL           AS is_new_service,
  COALESCE(
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - s.last_event_time))::int,
    999999
  )                                   AS elapsed_since_last_sec,
  COALESCE(
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - s.cascade_start_time))::int,
    999999
  )                                   AS cascade_elapsed_sec
FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy
LEFT JOIN afd_states s
  ON s.source_id = '{{ $json.source_id }}'
 AND '{{ $json.source_id }}' <> ''

INSERT INTO afd_states (
  source_id, current_state, previous_state, last_symbol,
  last_event_time, cascade_count, cascade_start_time, updated_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.source_id }}',
  '{{ $json.afd_state }}',
  '{{ $json.previous_state }}',
  '{{ $json.afd_symbol }}',
  NOW(),
  {{ $json.cascade_count }},
  CASE '{{ $json.cascade_reset }}'
    WHEN 'reset_now' THEN NOW()
    ELSE NULL
  END,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (source_id) DO UPDATE SET
  current_state      = EXCLUDED.current_state,
  previous_state     = EXCLUDED.previous_state,
  last_symbol        = EXCLUDED.last_symbol,
  last_event_time    = NOW(),
  cascade_count      = EXCLUDED.cascade_count,
  cascade_start_time = CASE '{{ $json.cascade_reset }}'
    WHEN 'reset_now'  THEN NOW()
    WHEN 'reset_null' THEN NULL
    ELSE afd_states.cascade_start_time
  END,
  updated_at         = NOW()
UPDATE logs SET afd_state = '{{ $json.afd_state }}', afd_symbol = '{{ $json.afd_symbol }}', previous_state = '{{ $json.previous_state }}' WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}

SELECT message 
FROM logs WHERE source_id = '{{ $json.source_id }}'
ORDER BY log_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM llm_cache
        WHERE message_hash = '{{ $json.message_hash }}'
    ) AS cache_found,
    (
        SELECT response_text
        FROM llm_cache
        WHERE message_hash = '{{ $json.message_hash }}'
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS response_text,
    (
        SELECT llm_source
        FROM llm_cache
        WHERE message_hash = '{{ $json.message_hash }}'
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS llm_source,
    (
        SELECT hit_count
        FROM llm_cache
        WHERE message_hash = '{{ $json.message_hash }}'
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS hit_count;

UPDATE llm_cache
SET
    hit_count = hit_count + 1,
    last_hit_at = NOW()
WHERE message_hash = '{{ $json.message_hash }}';

INSERT INTO llm_cache (
    message_hash,
    category,
    afd_state,
    response_text,
    llm_source,
    created_at,
    last_hit_at,
    hit_count
)
VALUES (
    '{{ $json.message_hash }}',
    '{{ $json.category }}',
    '{{ $json.afd_state }}',
    '{{ JSON.stringify({
        cause_probable: $json.cause_probable,
        actions_immediates: $json.actions_immediates,
        escalade_si: $json.escalade_si,
        severite_estimee: $json.severite_estimee
    }).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ $json.llm_source }}',
    NOW(),
    NOW(),
    1
)
ON CONFLICT (message_hash)
DO UPDATE SET
    last_hit_at = NOW(),
    hit_count = llm_cache.hit_count + 1;
